target_scope.description: Working past-18-years window for architecture-related administrative and documented milestones. Records are evidence of the stated source milestone only, not evidence of construction outcomes unless the source explicitly states completion or opening.

london.title: Planning London Datahub applications
london.publisher: Greater London Authority / Planning London Datahub
caveats: Planning applications, decisions, commencement fields and completion fields are administrative/source-reported milestones.
Planning approval is not construction. PLD lifecycle fields should not be framed as opening, occupation, final built form, or outcome evidence.
Borough source geometry may be missing, approximate or later revised.
next_checks: Clarify dataset licence and redistribution terms.
Keep row-level application URLs and LPA references for source briefs.
Spot-check PLD rows against borough planning portals before promoting high-profile events.

london.title: London Development Database planning permissions archive
caveats: LDD is an archive of selected permissions and monitoring records, not a full application-level source after PLD replaced it.
Completion fields are source-reported administrative monitoring fields and should be labelled as such.
next_checks: Retain archive file version and field dictionary in raw metadata.
Prefer PLD for post-2020 rows.

london.title: Planning Data listed building outlines
london.publisher: Department for Levelling Up, Housing and Communities / Planning Data
caveats: Listed-building geometry records administrative designation or data-maintenance state, not a construction event.
Dates may reflect dataset/entity lifecycle dates rather than real-world building change dates.
next_checks: Link listed-building outline entities to NHLE list entry identifiers where possible.
Keep designation changes distinct from planning applications and refurbishments.

london.title: Historic England National Heritage List for England open data
caveats: Heritage-list updates are legal/administrative heritage records, not evidence of refurbishment, demolition or public opening.
Heritage at Risk status is risk/condition context and should not be counted as built change.
next_checks: Record layer name, service URL, query parameters and access timestamp for each extract.
Separate listed-building designation, certificate of immunity, de-designation and heritage-at-risk records.

london.title: London borough planning portals and document packs
caveats: Borough portals are source-of-record for documents but have heterogeneous schemas, fragile URLs and personal-data risks.
Planning reports are evidence of committee process and stated recommendations/decisions only.
next_checks: Use PLD row IDs to decide which borough document packs need spot-checking.
Store document metadata and source URLs before scraping any document text.

nyc.title: DOB Permit Issuance
nyc.publisher: NYC Department of Buildings / NYC Open Data
caveats: Permit issuance is an administrative permit milestone, not construction start, completion or legal occupancy.
Address/BIN/BBL fields require geocoding or parcel joins for geometry.
next_checks: Join to BIN/BBL geometry through MapPLUTO or Digital Tax Map.
Link permit rows to DOB job filings and DOB NOW records where job filing numbers align.

nyc.title: DOB Job Application Filings
nyc.publisher: NYC Department of Buildings / NYC Open Data
caveats: DOB job filings are administrative applications and status records, not evidence that work occurred.
Legacy BIS and DOB NOW schemas overlap and need deduplication by job number/address/date.
next_checks: Treat demolition job types as demolition-permit or application records unless a separate source states demolition occurred.
Link status transitions to permit issuance and certificate-of-occupancy datasets.

nyc.title: DOB NOW: Build - Job Application Filings
nyc.publisher: NYC Department of Buildings / NYC Open Data
caveats: DOB NOW filing status is administrative. It does not by itself evidence construction start, completion or opening.
DOB NOW records should be linked to approved permits and certificates for lifecycle views.
next_checks: Strengthen lifecycle linking between DOB NOW filing, approved permit and certificate-of-occupancy records.
Document DOB NOW/BIS cutover coverage gaps.

nyc.title: DOB NOW: Build - Approved Permits
nyc.publisher: NYC Department of Buildings / NYC Open Data
caveats: Approved permit rows are permit-administration records, not evidence that work started or was completed.
Electrical, elevator and limited alteration permits may be represented in separate datasets.
next_checks: Join to DOB NOW job filings and certificate-of-occupancy rows by job filing number.
Classify work types conservatively and exclude personal fields.

nyc.title: DOB Certificate Of Occupancy
nyc.publisher: NYC Department of Buildings / NYC Open Data
caveats: A certificate of occupancy is legal occupancy evidence, not a complete construction narrative or public opening notice.
Temporary and final certificate types must remain distinct.
next_checks: Separate temporary and final certificate events.
Join to permit and job filing rows when producing source briefs.

nyc.title: DOB NOW: Certificate of Occupancy
nyc.publisher: NYC Department of Buildings / NYC Open Data
caveats: DOB NOW certificates are administrative occupancy records, not general opening announcements.
DOB NOW and legacy CO coverage must be deduplicated.
next_checks: Link DOB NOW CO rows back to DOB NOW permits by job filing name.
Keep temporary and final certificate status visible in event summaries.

nyc.title: LPC Permit Application Finder / Permit Search
caveats: LPC permits authorize or document review of work at designated properties; they are not completion or construction-outcome records.
Pre-2016 records may require records access rather than portal search.
next_checks: Resolve a stable source URL strategy for each permit result.
Link permit rows to LPC designation data and DOB permit rows where feasible.

nyc.title: Zoning Application Portal project and BBL data
nyc.publisher: NYC Department of City Planning / NYC Open Data
caveats: ZAP tracks land-use process milestones; it is not evidence of construction, completion or outcomes.
Some projects affect areas not expressible as a single BBL geometry.
next_checks: Join ZAP project rows to the ZAP BBL table and retain project portal URLs.
Keep ULURP, environmental and public-status milestones distinct.

nyc.title: Public Design Commission annual report / project submissions dataset
nyc.publisher: NYC Public Design Commission / NYC Open Data
caveats: Design Commission review is a design-review milestone, not construction approval, funding commitment, completion or opening.
Geometry often needs project-address or agency/site geocoding.
next_checks: Verify actual column names in the live dataset before bulk ingestion.
Avoid redistributing drawings or images from project submissions.

nyc.title: Affordable Housing Production by Building
nyc.publisher: NYC Department of Housing Preservation and Development / NYC Open Data
caveats: HPD production records describe housing-program milestones and should not be used as universal NYC construction completion records.
Construction start/completion field names and definitions must be preserved in event summaries.
next_checks: Verify the live Socrata dataset id before production refresh.
Deduplicate against DOB CO and DCP Housing Database records.

belfast.title: Northern Ireland Planning Statistics annual and quarterly datasets
caveats: Planning statistics are administrative application/decision records, not construction, completion, occupation or public-opening evidence.
Annual/quarterly statistical fields may be month/period precision rather than exact application-event dates.
next_checks: Expand Belfast application-level annual CSV coverage and preserve row-level variable descriptions.
Link statistics rows to NI Planning Portal records where references align.

belfast.title: Northern Ireland Planning Portal public register
caveats: Portal application and decision dates are planning-process dates, not evidence of works or completion.
Portal documents can contain personal data or third-party copyright.
next_checks: Prefer official export/API access if available; otherwise collect only metadata with polite request pacing.
Resolve stable source URLs and row IDs for each portal record.

belfast.title: Belfast City Council current planning applications
caveats: The current list is not a historical backfile and should not be used as full 2008-2026 coverage.
Advertised or valid dates are not approvals, works starts, completions or openings.
next_checks: Pair current-list rows with NI Planning Portal and committee records.
Backfill annual application-level CSVs and portal exports where available.

belfast.title: Belfast City Council Planning Committee agenda items, minutes and report packs
caveats: Committee approval or refusal is an administrative planning milestone only.
Committee packs can include applicant claims, consultees and personal data; summaries must avoid copying sensitive text.
next_checks: Deduplicate against NI Planning Portal and DfI statistics by application reference.
Keep officer recommendation and committee decision distinct.

belfast.title: Historic Environment Division Buildings Database
belfast.publisher: Department for Communities, Northern Ireland / Historic Environment Division
caveats: Listing or de-listing is an administrative heritage change, not a refurbishment, demolition or opening event.
Coordinate precision may reflect register geometry rather than surveyed building footprint.
next_checks: Record service URL, layer id and query parameters for each extract.
Separate listing, de-listing, grade/current-use changes and heritage-at-risk indicators.

belfast.title: Heritage at Risk in Northern Ireland Belfast records
belfast.publisher: Department for Communities, Northern Ireland / Historic Environment Division
caveats: Heritage at Risk records describe register/risk status, not construction, refurbishment or demolition.
Risk status should not be counted as architecture delivery.
next_checks: Pair HARNI changes with HED listed-building records and official project pages where a repair/opening is claimed.
Keep risk-status rows visually distinct from planning and permit rows.

belfast.title: Belfast official civic, harbour, transport, education, university and project pages
belfast.publisher: Belfast City Council, Belfast Harbour, Translink, Department of Education, Ulster University and other official project owners
caveats: Official project pages support only the milestone they state, such as a published opening or works-start notice.
Forward-looking project descriptions, funding statements and anticipated dates must not be treated as delivered outcomes.
next_checks: Prefer official owner/operator pages over media articles for openings and completions.
Add source-specific terms and retrieval timestamps to every manual candidate pack.

rejection_rules: Reject records with no licence or unresolved terms for public redistribution unless only minimal factual metadata and source URLs are retained with a clear rights caveat.
Reject records with no usable source date or only a retrieval date.
Reject records with no geometry, geometry reference or affected-area label.
Reject records that require ingesting private personal data, planning representations, signatures, private contact details or applicant documents without review.
Reject records whose summary implies causality, speculative future modelling, construction outcome, completion or opening beyond the source wording.
dedupe_rules: Exact source row id and source id first.
Then compare address/site name, effective date, event type and geometry or affected area.
Merge evidence references when records describe the same administrative milestone; do not delete raw rows.
Keep separate events for distinct lifecycle milestones from the same project, such as application, decision, permit issued, commencement, completion and opening.

caveats: Counts are coverage of the current source-backed architecture package, not complete city coverage.
Planning approval is not construction, permit issuance is not completion, and source-reported lifecycle fields are labelled by source date field.
Manual project pages and official press releases support only the stated milestone. Forward-looking dates remain caveated and are not counted as delivered outcomes.
priority_gaps: Belfast: continue application-level annual planning CSV and NI Planning Portal linking for row-level geometry and exact decisions.
London: deepen borough planning document links beyond PLD summaries, especially for listed-building consent and demolition/refurbishment evidence.
NYC: strengthen lifecycle linking across DOB NOW filings, approved permits, legacy DOB permits, LPC permits and certificates of occupancy.
